The '''Port Pixelito Authority''' was the organization that operated [[Port Pixelito]] on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="HNN54" /> During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Port Pixelito Authority received 45,000 surplus [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK-series worker droids]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to offset the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] workers furloughed due to security concerns<ref name="HNN54" />. A series of commed-in bomb threats, an increase in native Dug hostility, and the death of [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}}</ref> forced the government of Malastare to attempt to root out extremism among the native Dugs by suspending them from their jobs. They made up nearly 60 percent of the porters and service staff working at the port.<ref name="HNN54" />
